args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.
2.9.4 is the fixed release in the 2.x line.

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 (fix CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4.

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions: <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0. Fixed in 2.9.4 (also 3.1.0). We take the minimal fix in the current 2.x line.

CI passed on this branch (run ci-0001, sha c8b8ab7878).
